brief: Priority 1 is to enter at map reference (29.63822, -89.95027) and a crew entering here is closest to 7 isolated buildings [F3]. Buildings are 7 isolated cut off from every exit road, 0 uncertain, 0 still reachable, and 0 with no mapped road nearby [F2]. 67 road pieces were checked with 33 judged flooded, 14 uncertain, and the rest judged dry [F1]. In testing on 5 SpaceNet 8 tiles none of the 27 truly cut-off buildings was marked reachable but about half of the buildings marked isolated were in fact reachable and treat isolated as a reason to check not a confirmed cut-off [F4]. Flood judgements come from a vision model reading satellite photos and are not field-verified and uncertain roads need a drone or ground check [F5].
